2607.08793.title: EHR-MPC: Inference-Time Control for Sepsis Treatment with Generative Patient Digital Twins
2607.08793.paper_summary: Sepsis is a leading cause of mortality, yet optimal treatment policies remain contested. Existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches learn fixed strategies for sepsis treatment, limiting adaptability to changing clinical objectives during inference. We propose EHRMPC, a framework that decouples learning patient dynamics from optimizing treatment by training a patient digital twin in the form of a generative electronic health record (EHR) model. The digital twin predicts clinical trajectories under interventions and enables model predictive control (MPC) to optimize treatments via inference-time planning over simulations. We evaluate EHR-MPC on a multicenter ICU sepsis cohort spanning 8 hospitals in the Mass General Brigham health system using both off-policy importance sampling and on-policy simulation-based evaluation. Relative to RL baselines, EHR-MPC achieves comparable off-policy performance and improved simulation performance. Unlike RL, this work frames sepsis treatment optimization as inference-time control over learned patient dynamics, establishing a general framework for decision making with generative clinical models.
2607.08793.paper_summary_zh: 敗血症是主要的死亡原因之一，但最佳的治療政策仍然存在爭議。現有的強化學習 (RL) 方法為敗血症治療學習固定策略，限制了在推斷過程中對變化的臨床目標的適應性。我們提出了 EHRMPC，一個將學習患者動態與優化治療解耦的框架，通過訓練一個以生成電子健康記錄 (EHR) 模型形式的患者數位雙胞胎來實現。數位雙胞胎預測干預下的臨床軌跡，並使模型預測控制 (MPC) 能夠通過推斷時的規劃來優化治療。我們在涵蓋麻省總醫院布萊根健康系統的 8 家醫院的多中心 ICU 敗血症隊列上評估 EHR-MPC，使用了基於離線策略的重要性抽樣和基於在線策略的模擬評估。相對於 RL 基準，EHR-MPC 實現了可比的離線策略性能和改進的模擬性能。與 RL 不同的是，這項工作將敗血症治療優化框架化為對學習患者動態的推斷時控制，建立了一個使用生成臨床模型進行決策的通用框架。
